summary: Resolved Sunday 29 November 2026 to identity 01, Dominica prima Adventus, I classis, Statio ad S. Mariam maiorem (Missale Romanum 1962, printed pp. 1-2, nos. 1-10, PDF 82-83, read at 200/400 dpi on the registered CMAA facsimile fetched to its registered hash). RG 20 (Sunday nearest 30 November) places it; the ordinary commemoration of St Saturninus (Calendarium p. LII; Sanctorale p. 428) is excluded on a I-class day by RG 109 and 111 a. Violet, no Gloria (printed rubric, RGMR 432 b), Credo, Trinity Preface, Ite missa est; no branch on the Sunday (the Alleluia omission and common Preface apply only to Advent ferias using this Mass). Computation, printed rubrics and calendar, and two dated Ordos (FSSP France, ICRSP France) agree. Not reference-only. research/context.md records the complete ten-element inventory with loci, oration conclusions (Qui vivis ... cum Deo Patre / full Per Dominum / short Per Dominum nostrum), wording against the Clementine (Ad te levavi without Domine, qui te exspectant, Gradual notas fac mihi beside the Introit verse's demonstra mihi, Epistle ending at v. 14a, Gospel dropping Et, Communion dropping Etenim), the Ordinary's appointed parts, lawful Latin and English routes, and the remaining verification plan; main.tex holds only the reserved-owner scaffold comment.
